gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-inscri: Noto Sans Inscriptional Parthian reads wide and friendly, its e and a eyes gaping and the middle band running deep. And Almendra Display, ornate and literary above it, gets room to flourish without the text ever feeling crowded.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-jp: Almendra Display has an ornate, literary pull, with letters that refuse to pinch shut. Noto Sans JP is the practical counterpart, its tall x-height and sweeping curves built for steady reading rather than flourish.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-gunjala-gondi: Noto Sans Gunjala Gondi reads open and contemporary, with terminals cut back to leave generous gaps. Audiowide sits over it like tiles laid with wide grout, futuristic and uniform, so the two feel clearly separate.
gen-fs-oswald-gf-lexend-peta: Lexend Peta is approachable, with a big x-height and curves that never thin. Over a full page its wide-mouthed c shapes keep text moving smoothly, while Oswald's tightly knit rows above it stay confident and strong.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-kaithi: Noto Sans Kaithi fills its lines with sturdy, capital-like lowercase. Its open e channel gives Almendra Display, ornate and literary with letters that never pinch shut, a quiet counterpart that lets the heading's character stand out.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-hebrew: Noto Sans Hebrew has a dominant midsection and wide gaps between curve ends and stems. Audiowide's tile-like, uniform-stroke glyphs give the heading a futuristic edge, while the body stays low in contrast and modern underneath.
gen-special-elite-gf-fauna-one: Distressed and typewriter-rough, with a lowercase a that gapes wide. Fauna One, a literary and dignified serif with a tall middle band and shallow ascenders, calms Special Elite's grit and gives the whole thing a grounded footing.
gen-audiowide-gf-noto-sans-lydian: Futuristic is the first word for Audiowide, whose strokes never swell or pinch and whose glyphs sit like tiles. Noto Sans Lydian, approachable and low in contrast, grounds it nicely.
gen-fs-oswald-switzer: Confident rows of Oswald sit tightly knit, strong and compact up top. Switzer follows with wire-like, marker-traced letterforms and a tall waist line, so a long stretch of text reads in a friendly, Swiss way.
gen-almendra-display-gf-noto-sans-meetei: Almendra Display is ornate and literary, its letters never pinching shut and its x-height standing tall in large type. It earns its keep big and short.
